svg.title: Rank comparison — new visualization of archived research data

cc:Work.dc:title: Rank comparison — new visualization of archived research data
cc:Work.dc:description: ProGAL-VLA: observed-score mean rank99 versus archived2PL point-estimate rank22. The77-rank disagreement is not accuracy, improvement or true ranking. All162 original model rank pairs are drawn. Additional masking0.
